io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.storage.backend.jdbc

Class MySqlProvider

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.storage.backend.jdbc.MySqlProvider

  • public class MySqlProvider
extends java.lang.Object
    ConnectionProvider for MySQL: a single validated Connection, no pool. Unlike EmbeddedH2Provider, a MySQL connection can legitimately drop (network blip, server restart, idle timeout), so conn() re-validates and reopens as needed instead of handing out one connection for the whole plugin lifetime.

    The MySQL driver is not shaded into the jar; it (and its protobuf dependency) is loaded from the classpath if present, else downloaded once into plugins/Slimefun/libraries by StorageDriverLoader. We connect through the Driver instance directly, since DriverManager cannot see a driver loaded by a child classloader.
